references.text: The land that the Lord has given his people as a possession, a theme also touched upon in Joshua 22:19 regarding the Lord's own land.
Warnings against defilement in the land and the consequences of making the land unclean, corresponding to the concern about an 'unclean land' in Joshua 22:19.
The dwelling of the Lord among his people, parallel to the 'dwelling of the Lord' (mishkan) mentioned in Joshua 22:19.
The one place the Lord has chosen for his dwelling, where offerings are to be brought – relevant to the prohibition against building an alternative altar.
Korah's rebellion as an example of rebellion against the Lord, corresponding to the warning 'do not rebel against the Lord' in Joshua 22:19.
The Israelites confirm that they would never build an altar to rebel against the Lord, apart from the Lord's altar.
Samuel warns the people against rebelling against the Lord, the same theme as in Joshua 22:19.
Accusation of rebellion against the king by building, parallel to the concern about rebellion by building a separate altar.
